name: ctx-suite
description: Context health, secret redaction, task-aware compaction shaping and cost-aware smart compaction timing (port of pi's context-manager + smart-compaction).

redact.title: Redact secrets in tool results
redact.description: Rewrite API keys, tokens, PEM keys and similar in every tool result before it is stored or sent. Permanent in the transcript.

redactPatterns.title: Extra redaction regexes
redactPatterns.description: Additional JavaScript regex sources, space-separated (write \s for a space); each scans only the first 64 KiB of a result.

shapeCompactions.title: Shape compaction input
shapeCompactions.description: Stub stale, superseded, duplicate and repeated-failure tool outputs before a compaction summarizes them, when its prompt cache is cold (on a hot cache stubs cost more than they save, so stale reads are named in the instructions instead). The newest ~40k tokens are never touched.

smartTiming.title: Smart compaction timing
smartTiming.description: After a turn, at idle, compact when the cost engine and relevance judge say it pays.

idleSeconds.title: Idle seconds before evaluating
idleSeconds.description: Quiet time after a turn before a smart-compaction evaluation (5-600).

compactBeforeExpiry.title: Compact before the cache expires
compactBeforeExpiry.description: Once per idle stretch, compact a context past the floor shortly before the prompt cache expires, so a return after the break does not re-write all of it. Needs smartTiming.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt-cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long Claude Code's prompt cache stays warm (5-60). The pre-expiry compaction runs at 50/60 of it.

qualityLine.title: Fire line (fraction of window)
qualityLine.description: Context fill at which compaction becomes rational (0.2-0.9).

reserveTokens.title: Overflow reserve tokens
reserveTokens.description: Tokens below the window treated as the overflow line, for warnings and the regrowth horizon.

judgeEnabled.title: Relevance judge: enabled
judgeEnabled.description: Ask a Claude model whether the old context is still needed; off uses the keyword heuristic.

judgeModel.title: Relevance judge: model
judgeModel.description: Model alias or id for the judge.

judgeEffort.title: Relevance judge: effort
judgeEffort.description: Thinking effort for the judge call.

judgeTimeoutMs.title: Relevance judge: timeout ms
judgeTimeoutMs.description: Abandon the judge call after this long (1000-60000); the heuristic answers instead.

judgeMaxExcerptChars.title: Relevance judge: max excerpt chars
judgeMaxExcerptChars.description: Most characters of redacted conversation sent to the judge (500-20000).

judgeMaxCallsPerHour.title: Relevance judge: max calls per hour
judgeMaxCallsPerHour.description: Rolling-hour cap on judge calls (0-60); past it the heuristic answers.

aggressiveBelow.title: Gate: aggressive below p
aggressiveBelow.description: A relevance probability below this compacts aggressively.

deferAbove.title: Gate: defer above p
deferAbove.description: A relevance probability above this defers the compaction.

allowAggressive.title: Gate: allow aggressive compaction
allowAggressive.description: Off: an aggressive verdict compacts as focused instead.

fallbackMayBeAggressive.title: Gate: heuristic may be aggressive
fallbackMayBeAggressive.description: Let the keyword heuristic (used when the judge fails) trigger an aggressive compaction.

driftToast.title: Task-switch drift toast
driftToast.description: Toast when a prompt looks unrelated to the active tasks in a full context.

dropAbusive.title: Drop abusive prompts
dropAbusive.description: Drop a prompt that is only insults, slurs or hostile profanity, with no task content, before it enters the session: it never reaches the model's context or the transcript. A local word list flags candidates; Haiku confirms the unclear ones. Negative feedback without abuse ("no, wrong again") always goes through.

scrubHistory.title: Remove dropped prompts from input history
scrubHistory.description: Also remove a dropped prompt from Claude Code's up-arrow history (~/.claude/history.jsonl), which records it before any hook runs. The file is rewritten whole, after checking nothing was appended since it was read; a session writing in that instant can still lose its line. Stops working once the file passes 4 MiB.
